description: You are a graphic designer retouching a portrait photograph for a client's annual report. Open the provided portrait photograph on your Desktop (portrait_photo.jpg). The photograph needs professional retouching before it is suitable for print publication: the tonal range is compressed and needs stretching to recover full contrast, the image has an undesirable color cast that needs correction, and the mid-tones need selective sharpening to recover detail lost during scanning. Additionally, the client requests a subtle darkened vignette around the edges to draw attention inward. Apply all four of these corrections and export the final retouched image as retouched_portrait.png to your Desktop.
